name: How long does a typical door threshold repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical door threshold repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a door threshold repair depends on the scope of the work. Minor repairs, such as sealing or filling small cracks, might only take a few hours. A full threshold replacement, however, can take anywhere from half a day to a full day, especially if there's extensive subfloor preparation or custom fitting involved. We strive to complete projects efficiently while ensuring high-quality results. Our team will provide an estimated timeline after assessing the specific damage and requirements for your project.
